title: Sughra Nu Teray Jaan Day Dardaan
body:
Sughra nu teray jaan day dardaan nay mukaya..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Na jaawee door Akbar dukhyari vayn aay paya..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Teri tak kay veer sawari main rowaan tay kurlawaan
Teri veer tayari nay beemar da marz wadhaya..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Chum seena veer Akbar da hamsheer da dil ghabraya
Mar jana main veeran jay tu pardes wasaya..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Beshak majboor tu Akbar meri akhiyan da noor aay
Rishta tera mera Rab pak azeem banaya..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Zainab nay maa Zahra da Abbas nay pue Haider da
Akbar nay babay tay Sajjad da farz nibhaya..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Turr paye mehmal phuphiyan tay mawaan day waro wari
Haye Sehar oh waikhdi rae jinu veer nay aap lahaya..
